name: BoxBuildV1
status: F78 (DECISION-LOG, 2026-10-04): the build profiles of core v1. `mainnet` is the reviewed build and the default; `rehearsal` is a testnet build whose raise and fixed ETH amounts are 1/10, so a curve fills with about 0.43 SepETH instead of 4.25.
about: One switch builds the rehearsal: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=rehearsal (packages/contracts/foundry.toml points `sh-box-build/` at src/box/build/rehearsal/ instead of src/box/build/mainnet/).

packages/box-spec/scripts/generate.mjs writes both BoxBuildV1.sol files, the BoxSpecV1 constants that read them and the TypeScript twin from this file; every scaled value must be its mainnet value times the profile's scale, exactly (no rounding).

The mainnet profile's values are the box-spec.v1.json constants and the version contexts' native-ETH raise preset; the generated BoxSpecV1.sol names them through BoxBuildV1, and the default build's bytecode is the same as before the profiles existed (docs/evidence/SH-rehearsal-build.md).

Scaled too: the creator-fee cap's five presets (add-ons.v1.json creator-fee-cap.capPerEpoch: 1, 4, 8, 16, 32 ETH per 30 days), fixed ETH amounts inside validate(). Only version 2 offers that add-on, which factory v1 cannot create, so in core v1 they change no reachable path; they keep a later version-2 rehearsal at the same 1/10.

A profile with `refusesChainIds` builds a constructor guard (BoxBuildGuard) into the factory, the planner and every implementation, so that build cannot be deployed on those chains; the deploy script refuses it there too.

scaled.name: RAISE
scaled.why: R: the curve holds exactly R, its ticks, liquidity and pool share are BoxLayoutV1.curve(R); the graduation reward (0.1% of R) and MIN_ADD (0.5% of R) follow it.

scaled.name: BOOTSTRAP_ETH
scaled.why: the burned bootstrap buy createBox sends (msg.value)

scaled.name: FEE_BATCH_TIP_MAX_ETH
scaled.why: the tip cap of collect(), deepen() and the swap module's steps

scaled.name: SWAP_STEP_MIN_Q
scaled.why: a swap-module step below it waits (BoxSwapModule; Standard boxes)

scaled.name: DEPTH_CONVERT_MIN_Q
scaled.why: a depth conversion alone waits below it (deepen's swap)

scaled.name: PLATFORM_CAP_WEI
scaled.why: box 0's platform share is capped at it per 30-day epoch

scaled.name: CREATOR_FEE_CAP_PRESET_0
scaled.why: the creator-fee cap's first preset per 30 days (F75 U9; version 2 only: factory v1 cannot create it)

scaled.name: CREATOR_FEE_CAP_PRESET_1
scaled.why: the creator-fee cap's second preset (version 2 only)

scaled.name: CREATOR_FEE_CAP_PRESET_2
scaled.why: the creator-fee cap's third preset (version 2 only)

scaled.name: CREATOR_FEE_CAP_PRESET_3
scaled.why: the creator-fee cap's fourth preset (version 2 only)

scaled.name: CREATOR_FEE_CAP_PRESET_4
scaled.why: the creator-fee cap's fifth preset (version 2 only)

notScaled: Shares of R or of a batch scale with them by themselves: GRADUATION_REWARD_CAP_BPS (0.1% of R), DEPTH_MIN_ADD_BPS_OF_RAISE (0.5% of R), FEE_BATCH_TIP_BPS, SWAP_STEP_TIP_BPS, DEPTH_CONVERT_SHARE_BPS, the fee shares and the vault's fees.
FIT_BURN_BATCH_MCAP_BPS is 0.05% of FIT's market cap at its 1-hour average, which a curve ten times thinner makes ten times smaller.
T amounts (ISSUANCE, CURVE_SHARE_TARGET), ticks, blocks, seconds and gas are not ETH amounts: the curve keeps its 26,880-tick span and its 80% share of T, centred where 80% of T buys R.
The drand posting bounty is DRAND_BOUNTY_GAS times the base fee (gas, not ETH).

profiles.name: mainnet
profiles.about: The reviewed build: mainnet's box 0 and the full-size Sepolia rehearsal (the profile may still be deployed on Sepolia).

profiles.name: rehearsal
profiles.about: F78: testnets only. The raise and the six fixed ETH amounts at 1/10 (and the creator-fee cap's presets, version 2 only); every other value as mainnet's. Its factory, planner and implementations refuse chain id 1 in their constructors (RehearsalBuildRefusesChain), and script/DeployCoreV1.s.sol refuses it on mainnet.
